description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m high, much branched; branchlets terete, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina obovate or elliptic, 3–10 by 2–4.5 cm, apex rounded or emarginate, base cuneate, with numerous minute pores on both surfaces; lateral nerves 7–11 pairs, slender, slightly raised on both sides; veinlets obscure. Umbels sessile or very short peduncled, usually many-flowered. Pedicel ca 1 cm. Flowers white, without bracteoles. Calyx-lobes oblique-oblong, ca 6 by 3 mm, gibbous and thickened at base. Corolla-tube ca 3.5 mm, villous within; lobes ovate to ovate-lanceolate, ca 6.5 by 3 mm, acute, reflexed. Stamens shorter than corolla; filaments 6–9 mm, base fused into a tube, densely villous, free part slightly longer than the tube, glabrous. Anthers ca 2.5 mm, dorsifixed. Ovary ovoid; style 6–8 mm, subulate, with black glandular dots. Fruit falcate or crescent-shaped, 5–8 cm long, acuminate at apex.
bibliographicCitation: Aegiceras corniculatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 176. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 0.3 m high; branches rather thick, drying brown, with scattered capitate hairs when young, later glabrous. Leaves ± crowded towards apex of young shoots; petiole ca 1 cm, winged by decurrent margins of the blade; lamina oblong-elliptic, 25–30 by 7.5–10 cm, apex acute or obtuse, tapering towards base, entire and narrowly recurved, glabrous, lower surface sparingly and minutely rusty scaly glandular dots numerous, irregularly scattered, convex when dry, chiefly visible on the upper surface; lateral nerves 10–14 pairs, slender, slightly elevated beneath, curved-ascending veinlets invisible. Inflorescence terminal, racemose, simple or occasionally branched, 4–5 cm long, ± pendant, with scattered capitate hairs. Pedicel 4–6 cm. Calyx ca 2.5 mm, split to ¾ of its length; lobes ovate, acute at apex, with scattered capitate hairs and glandular dots, glandular-ciliate. Corolla pink; tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 3.5 by 1.8 mm, with dark glandular dots and lines. Anthers oblong, ca 1.5 mm, apiculate. Ovary globose, densely black-punctate; style 3–4 mm. Drupe unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia alata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 112. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: In addition to the characters given in the key, differing from var. amherstiana in being more densely pilose on the young branches.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia amherstiana pubescens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 127. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, ca 20 cm high; branches thick, terete or slightly angular, glabrous. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina elliptic or obovate, 6–15 by 2 5–6 cm, apex obtuse or rounded, base attenuate, entire, glabrous, upper surface light brown when dry, lower glaucescent, with numerous tiny sunken dots; lateral nerves 6–10 pairs, obscure above, prominent beneath; veinlets invisible. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, 3–6 cm long, with a spread of 2–4 cm at base, 1x-branched, glabrous all over, each branch bearing 3–6 subumbellate flowers. Pedicel 2–4 mm. Calyx ca 1.75 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse or ± acute, dotted with small black glands, sparsely ciliolate. Corolla pink, ca 5 mm; tube very short; lobes ovate, acute, ca 2 mm wide, with scattered glandular dots and lines. Anthers 3–3.5 mm apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Drupe globose, ca 6 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia aprica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 127. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub ca 1 m high; stem rather thick, branchlets slender, slightly angular, glabrous. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 8–15 mm; lamina elliptic to narrowly elliptic, 10–16 by 3–5 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate, entire, glabrous, upper surface dark green, lower paler, light brown when dry, not punctate; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs, curving upwards to and along the margin; prominent beneath; veins and veinlets obscure. Inflorescence a slender panicle, terminal on branchlets, 1.5–3.5 cm long, glabrous, 1x-branched; branches 2–20 mm long, bearing 1–2 flowers. Pedicel 2–4 mm, ± glandular-puberulous. Calyx ca 2 mm, split to base; lobes ovate, ca 1 mm wide, acute, puberulous outside, indistinctly punctate. Corolla pink, ca 5 mm; tube 0.5–1 mm; lobes ovate, ca 2 mm wide, acute, not punctate. Anthers 2.75–3 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style slender, ca 4 mm. Drupe unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia atrovirens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 110. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–3 m high, glabrous throughout; branches terete, greyish brown, often with thickened base. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina ovate- elliptic to oblanceolate, sometimes elliptic, 8–19(–24) by 2.5(–6) cm, widest above middle, apex acuminate, rarely ± acute, base cuneate, entire, rarely obscurely denticulate near apex; glandular dots black, sometimes obscure, scattered in the areoles of reticulate venation; lateral nerves 10–14(–19) pairs; reticulation of veins distinct on lower surface. Inflorescence corymbose or subumbellate racemes, 2–8-flowered, in axils of caducous reduced leaves. Peduncle 2.5–4.5 cm. Pedicel 1–2 cm. Flowers white or sometimes pinkish, 8–9.5 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes broadly ovate, ca 2–2.5 by 2.5–3 mm, obtuse, dotted with dark glands, margin ± scarious, minutely ciliate. Corolla-tube 1.5–2 mm; lobes ovate-elliptic, 3.5–4 mm wide, acute, dotted with purplish or black, rounded and lineolate glands. Anthers lanceolate, 5–5.5 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 6–7 mm. Drupe globose, ca 6 mm diam, densely punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia attenuata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 129. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 12 m high; branchlets densely covered with ferruginous-pubescence, glabrescent, striate when dry. Leaves thinly coriaceous; petiole 10–12 mm, pubescent; lamina elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 7–15 by 2–4.5 cm, apex shortly acuminate or ± acute, base cuneate, entire, glabrous and slightly shining above, with scattered minute depressed rusty scales beneath; lateral nerves numerous, parallel, anastomosing at some distance from margin; reticulation of veins and veinlets distinct on both surfaces when dry. Inflorescence axillary, umbellate or corymbose, puberulous; rachis very short or up to 13 mm, rarely branched at base. Pedicel 7–13 mm. Calyx ca 2 mm, split almost to base; lobes ovate or oblong-ovate, obtuse, puberulous outside, obscurely punctate, minutely ciliate. Corolla white, ca 3.5 mm; tube very short; lobes broadly ovate, obtuse, 2–2.5 mm wide, with a very few brown glandular dots near apex. Anthers ovate, ca 2 mm. Ovary scurfy; style ca 2 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia betongensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 88. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, stems erect 30–100 cm high, unbranched, young parts and inflorescence covered with ferruginous short hairs. Leaves membranous to thinly chartaceous; petiole 6–10 mm; lamina narrowly elliptic, 9–18 by 3–3.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate, undulate-crenate, upper surface glabrous, lower very sparsely scurfy-puberulous or glabrescent; glandular dots many, black, scattered, more evident on young leaves; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs, slender, curved-ascending, ending in the marginal glands. Inflorescence in axils of reduced leaves near apex of stem, generally composed of 2 short stipitate umbels, each with 2–3 flowers. Peduncle 10–15 mm. Pedicel 7–12 mm. Calyx almost equaling the corolla, 4–5 mm, split almost to base; lobes linear-lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm wide, obtuse, puberulous outside, with scattered black glandular dots. Corolla pink, deeply lobed; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 3 mm, obtuse, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia bractescens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 145. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m high; young branches terete, or slightly angular, densely covered with ferruginous capitate hairs, glabrate and grey when mature. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–15 mm, covered with capitate hairs; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 12–20(–25) by 4–7 cm, apex acute to shortly acuminate, base cuneate, entire and slightly recurved, upper surface glabrous, lower with scattered rusty capitate hairs, especially on midrib; glandular dots numerous, pellucid or sometimes blackish and visible on both surfaces, lateral nerves 10–14 pairs, with short intermediates. Inflorescence a pendent raceme, lateral, in axils of reduced leaves near apex of branches, 6–12 cm long including the peduncle, ± covered with capitate hairs. Pedicel thick, 6–12(–20) mm. Calyx split almost to base; lobes broadly ovate to suborbicular, ca 2 mm diam, dotted with thick glands, distinctly ciliate. Corolla white to pink, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, ca 6 by 4 mm, ± acute, densely dotted with black glands. Anthers ca 3.5 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Drupe globose, 6–7 mm diam, densely punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia collinsiae. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 116. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–5 m high, young branches ferruginous-lepidote, ± compressed. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 8–15 mm; lamina lanceolate to oblong- lanceolate, 13–28 by 3–8 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate or obtuse, entire, glabrous, lower surface sparsely and minutely rusty-lepidote; glandular dots many, scattered, obscure or slightly convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, with short intermediates; reticulation of veins slightly prominent beneath. Panicle terminal, pyramidal, 10–18 cm long, with a spread of 8–15 cm at base, 2–3 branched; rachis and branches ± rusty-lepidote and flattened; ultimate branchlets terminating in subumbellate clusters of 2–12 flowers. Pedicel 2–3 mm, glabrous or minutely puberulous, thickened in fruit. Flowers pale pink, 2.5–3 mm. Calyx ca 1 mm, split to ⅔ of its length, lobes triangular, acute or obtuse, black-punctulate, minutely ciliate. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes oblong-elliptic, obtuse, not punctate. Anthers ovate-lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm. Ovary conical-ovoid, glabrous; style slender, ca 4 mm, exserted before anthesis. Drupe globose, 4–5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia colorata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 101. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree; branchlets terete, glabrous. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 2–3 cm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate, 16–27 by 3.5–6.5 cm, apex long-acuminate, base cuneate, obscurely undulate-crenate, with indistinct marginal glands, glabrous on both surfaces; glandular dots numerous, orange, scattered, evident only with illumination; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, with short intermediates; reticulation of veins prominent on both surfaces. Inflorescence compound-umbellate, glabrous, terminal on branches, these bearing only two leaves near apex. Peduncle very short, 2–4 mm; primary rays 5–20 mm. Pedicel ca 15 mm. Calyx ca 1.75 mm, deeply split; lobes broadly ovate, ca 1.8 mm wide, obtuse, densely dotted with brown glands, minutely ciliate. Drupe globose, ca 6 mm diam, longitudinally striate and with black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia confusa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 136. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1.2 m high; branchlets compressed, striate when dry, glabrous, with scattered rusty peltate scales and faint black dots. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 20–26 by 5–6.5 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base cuneate, entire, upper surface dull green, lower paler, dotted with small black glands; lateral nerves 20–24 pairs; reticulation of veins and veinlets distinct on both surfaces. Flowers in subsessile umbels crowded in leaf axils. Pedicel 1–5 mm, sparsely scurfy-puberulous. Calyx ca 1.25 mm, deeply split; lobes narrowly ovate, obtuse, with thick glandular dots on both sides. Corolla-tube ca 1 mm; lobes lanceolate, ca 5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide at base, ± obtuse, with a few glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 4 mm, subsessile, long-acuminate and awn-shaped. Ovary glabrous; style slender, ca 4 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia congesta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 87. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, 1–3 m rarely to 5 m high; branchlets terete, fulvous-pubescent when young. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–8 mm; lamina oblong-lanceolate to narrowly oblong, 8–15 by 2–3.8 cm, apex acuminate, base broadly cuneate to obtuse, subentire or undulate, rarely scalloped-crenate, with distinct marginal glands, glabrous above, ± pubescent below; glandular dots many, black, scattered, chiefly visible on lower surface; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, curved-ascending, anastomosing near margin, with branches ending in marginal glands. Inflorescence compound-umbellate, ferruginous puberulous, terminal on branches. Peduncle stout, 5–10 mm; primary rays 1–3 cm, each bearing 2–4-flowers. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm, thickened towards apex. Calyx ca 3 mm, split to ⅔ of its length or a little below; lobes ovate or oblong-ovate, ca 1.75 mm wide, acute or obtuse, glabrous or slightly puberulous outside, thickly dotted with black glands. Corolla white or pink, 6–8 mm, deeply lobed; lobes broadly ovate, ca 4 mm wide, acute, with scattered black glands. Anthers ovate or broadly lanceolate, ca 5 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 5–6 mm. Drupe globose, 7–8 mm diam, pinkish-red, with small black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia corymbifera corymbifera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 133. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Differs from var. corymbifera in having branchlets and undersides of leaves densely and persistently covered with multicellular hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia corymbifera euryoides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 134. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, 1–2 m rarely to 3 m high; branchlets slender, terete or slightly angular, glabrous, generally bearing 2–3-leaves close to the apices. Leaves subcoriaceous or chartaceous; petiole 4–10 mm; lamina elliptic-lanceolate or oblanceolate, 6–15(–20) by 2–4 cm, apex acute or acuminate, base cuneate, crisp- or undulate-crenate, ± recurved, with large marginal glands, glabrous, with minute rusty scales on lower surface; glandular dots many, scattered, black or sometimes colourless, slightly convex when dry; lateral nerves 12–18 pairs, meeting in an irregular intramarginal vein near edge; veins usually obscure. Inflorescence subumbellate or corymbose, simple or compound, terminal on branchlets, glabrous or puberulous. Peduncle none or very short; primary rays (if present) 2–4 cm. Pedicel 0.5–1 cm. Calyx split almost to base, lobes ovate to oblong-ovate, ca 1.5 mm, acute, obtuse or rounded, punctate. Corolla white or pinkish, 4–6 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, acute, ca 3 mm wide, with scattered glandular dots. Anthers triangular-lanceolate, ca 4 mm, usually punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5 mm. Drupe globose, bright red, with black glandular dots, 6–8 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia crenata crenata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 135. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub to 1.5 m high; stems rather thick, glabrous or nearly so. Leaves crowded near apex of stem, sessile or with a very short, winged petiole; lamina elliptic to elliptic-oblanceolate, 18–30 by 5–9 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base attenuate, margin minutely and obtusely denticulate, membranous, upper surface glabrous, lower surface with scattered minute light brown capitate hairs, especially on midrib; glandular dots and short lines numerous and minute, black, chiefly visible on lower surface; lateral nerves 10–12 pairs, with branches ending in teeth; veins and veinlets conspicuous beneath. Inflorescence paniculate, in axils of reduced leaves, covered with capitate hairs. Peduncle 7–12 cm, pendent after flowering; rachis 2–5 cm, with racemosely arranged branches, these 1–1.5 cm long, each bearing a subumbellate cluster of 2–4 flowers. Pedicel 1–1.3 cm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes broadly ovate, ca 1.2 by 1 mm, acute or obtuse, glabrous, dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes narrowly ovate, ca 7.5 by 3 mm, acuminate, black punctate. Anthers oblong, ca 3.5 mm, emarginated. Ovary glabrous; style curved. Drupe globose, ca 7 mm diam, bright red, with black glandular dots and lines.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia curvistyla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, ca 0.5 m high (ex Kerr); branchlets slender, terete, dark green to blackish, young parts and inflorescence densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 8–15 mm, rusty scaly; lamina elliptic-lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, 8–13.5 by 2.5–4.5 cm, apex acuminate, tip ± blunt, base cuneate, entire, obscurely undulate, upper surface glabrous, dull olive-brown when dry, lower paler, rather densely covered with minute rusty scales; lateral nerves 15–22 pairs, with several short intermediates, irregularly spaced, curved-ascending, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; reticulation of veins distinct on both surfaces. Inflorescence subumbellate, simple or compound, lateral near apex of branches. Peduncle 1–1.5 cm. Pedicel 4–7 mm. Calyx split almost to base; lobes triangular-ovate, ca 1 mm, acute, puberulous, minutely ciliate. Corolla ca 2.5 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, acute, ca 2 mm wide, with scattered dark glandular dots and lines. Anthers ovate, ca 1.25 mm, apiculate, black-punctulate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 2 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia cymosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 95. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to 9 m high; branchlets terete or somewhat angular, upper parts densely covered by rusty scurfy tomentum. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-lanceolate or slightly oblanceolate, 6–12 by 1.5–4 cm, apex shortly acuminate or ± acute, base cuneate, entire, glabrous, rather densely covered with appressed rusty peltate scales on lower surface; glandular dots and lines many, scattered, translucent; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge. Inflorescence subumbellate, simple or compound, 2–4 lateral near apex of branches, like a terminal corymb. Peduncle 1–2.5 cm, rusty-scaly, usually with 1–3 branches ca 2.5 mm long; each branch bearing 2–4 umbellate flowers. Pedicel 2–5 mm. Calyx split almost to base; lobes triangular-ovate to ovate-lanceolate, ca 1–1.25 mm, acute, distinctly ciliolate. Corolla pink, ca 3 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, acute, ca 1.75 mm wide, not punctate or with a few brown glands. Anthers ovate, ca 1.75 m, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style 4 mm, exserted before anthesis. Drupe subglobose, ca 7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia eglandulosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 93. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, usually 1–4 m, occasionally up to 10 m high, glabrous throughout; branchlets terete or slightly angular, greyish brown. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous; petioles 10–15 mm; lamina elliptic to obovate-oblong, 6–12 by 2.5–5 cm, apex bluntly acute to rounded, base cuneate, entire; glandular dots many, scattered, pellucid, evident only with illumination, or sometimes blackish and visible on both surfaces; lateral nerves 13–18 pairs, invisible in fresh plants, obscure in dry specimens; veins and veinlets usually obscure. Inflorescence corymbose racemes, (2–)4–8-flowered, in axils of normal leaves on the upper parts of branches. Peduncle 1.5–2.5 cm. Pedicel 8–15 mm. Flowers pink, 8–9 mm. Calyx ca 3 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes broadly ovate to orbicular, ca 2.5 mm wide, obtuse, thickly dotted with brown or black glands, margin ± scarious, distinctly ciliate. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes lanceolate, 3–3.5 mm wide, acuminate, with scattered purple glandular lines. Anthers lanceolate, ca 5 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 6 mm. Drupe slightly depressed globose, grey, with dark purple dots, ca 6 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia elliptica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 128. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1.5 m high; branchlets terete or obtusely quadrangular, young parts densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–1.5 (2) cm; lamina elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 8–12 by 2.8–6 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base broadly cuneate, entire, glabrous, lower surface covered with minute appressed rusty scales; glandular dots small, numerous indistinct; lateral nerves (12–)16–24 pairs, irregularly spaced, meeting in an indistinct intramarginal vein; reticulation of veins very fine. Inflorescence subumbellate, lateral near apex of branchlets, like a terminal corymbose-panicle, rusty scaly. Common peduncle 15–35 mm; branches 4–15 mm, bearing 3–8 subumbellate flowers. Pedicel 5–10 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes narrowly ovate, ca 0.75 mm, acute, scaly outside, minutely ciliate. Corolla pink; tube ca 0.75 mm; lobes ovate ca 3 mm long, 2 mm wide, acute, with scattered pellucid glands. Anthers ovate, ca 1.75 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 4 mm, exserted before anthesis. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia ferrugineopilosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 97. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1.5 m high, glabrous throughout; branchlets terete, slender, marked with raised leaf scars. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 3–5 mm; lamina lanceolate 5–10 by 1.2–2 2 cm, apex long-acuminate, base cuneate, entire; glandular dots many, black, in the areoles of reticulate venation; lateral nerve 10–12 pairs, with short intermediates; reticulation of veins distinct on both surfaces. Inflorescence 2-flowered umbels, in axils of caducous bracts or reduced leaves near apex of branches. Peduncle slender, 13–20 mm. Pedicel 25–30 mm, slightly thickened towards apex in fruit. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes broadly ovate, ca 1.5 by 1.2 mm, rounded, densely dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla lobed almost to base; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 6.5–7 by 2.75 mm, acute, rather densely marked with black glandular dots and lines. Anthers lanceolate, ca 4.5 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 4 mm. Drupe globose, 5–6 mm diam, longitudinally striate and with black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia ficifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 128. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 2 m high; branches obtusely quadrangular or terete, young parts sparsely covered with minute ferruginous capitate hairs. Leaves clustered or subverticillate; petiole 1.5–3 cm; lamina oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 10–25 by 3–8 cm, apex shortly acuminate or ± acute, base cuneate or subacute, finely fimbriate-serrulate, chartaceous, glabrous, with numerous scattered minute slightly raised glandular dots, chiefly visible on lower surface; lateral nerves 20–30 pairs, prominent beneath, with branches ending in teeth. Inflorescence a slender corymbose-panicle, 8.5–15 cm long including the peduncle, 1.5–4 cm wide at base, slightly puberulous. Pedicel 5–10 mm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes ovate, ca 0.8 mm, glabrous, dotted with black glands along midvein. Corolla white, 4–4.5 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, ca 2 mm wide, obtuse or ± acute, with scattered purple glandular dots and short lines. Anthers ovate, ca 2 mm, obtuse punctate on back. Ovary glabrous. Drupe unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia fimbriata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 148. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1 m high; branchlets terete, densely ferruginous-tomentose when young, glabrous later. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 1 cm; lamina oblong to oblong-elliptic, 10–18 by 4–6 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base shortly narrowed, entire, glabrous on both surfaces; lateral nerves numerous and nearly all equal in thickness, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal nerve near edge. Inflorescence compound- corymbose, lateral or pseudoterminal, densely ferruginous-puberulous. Peduncle 2–15 mm; branches 1–2 cm, bearing 4–8 subumbellate flowers; pedicel 4–6 mm. Calyx ca 1.5 mm, deeply split; lobes triangular, acute, puberulous and black-punctate outside, distinctly ciliate. Corolla pink, ca 4.5 mm; tube ca 0.75 mm; lobes ovate, ca 3 mm wide, acute, with scattered dark glandular dots and short line. Anthers ovate, ca 2.5 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 4.5 mm, exserted before anthesis.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia fletcheri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 91. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, 30–60 cm high; branches slender, terete, densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves rigidly chartaceous; petiole ca 3 mm, rusty scaly; lamina elliptic- lanceolate or narrowly elliptic, 2.5–5 by 1–1.6 cm, apex acute or subacuminate, tip blunt, cuneately tapering to the obtuse or rounded base, entire, lower surface with scattered rusty peltate scales; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge. Inflorescence umbellate, with 2-(1) flowers, axillary on the upper part of branches or pseudoterminal, glabrous or nearly so. Peduncle 2–5 mm. Pedicel 5–7 mm, flowers pink, ca 4 mm. Calyx split almost to base; lobes ovate, ca 1.5 mm long, acute or subobtuse, dotted with black glands, ciliolate. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes broadly ovate, acute, sparsely punctate. Anthers ovate apiculate, not punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style equaling corolla-lobes. Drupe globose, 5–6 mm diam, deep red with black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia fordii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 89. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub; branches terete or slightly angular, young parts and inflorescence densely fulvous-puberulous. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–15 mm; lamina lanceolate to elliptic lanceolate, 7–17 by 2–4.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate, entire, upper surface glabrous, lower puberulous mainly on the midrib; glandular dots many, black, chiefly visible on lower surface; lateral nerves 15–18 pairs, rather fine, curved-ascending; veins obscure. Inflorescence axillary, subumbellate, 4–5-flowered. Peduncle slender, 1.5–2 cm. Pedicel 8–13 mm. Flowers pink, ca 6 mm. Calyx ca 2 mm, deeply split; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 1.25 mm wide, obtuse, not overlapping at base, puberulous, dotted with dark glands, distinctly ciliate. Corolla-tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes elliptic ca 3 mm wide, acute, with scattered black or purplish glandular dots and lines. Anthers ca 3.25 mm, apiculate, with a few glandular dots on back. Ovary glabrous; style 3.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia furva. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 126. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Subshrub or shrub ca 1 m rarely to 3 m high, with a thick creeping rhizome; stems erect, rather thick, mostly unbranched, puberulous when young. Leaves mostly crowded near apex of stem, rarely subverticillate; petiole 1.5–4 cm, narrowly winged; lamina elliptic to elliptic- or oblong-oblanceolate, 15–48 by 6–17 cm, apex acute or subacuminate, base cuneate, decurrent to the petiole, fimbriate-serrulate, subchartaceous, glabrous or slightly pubescent on lower surface, with scattered distinctly raised glandular dots on both surfaces; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs. Inflorescence axillary or subterminal, paniculate, covered with minute capitate hairs, 25–35 cm long including the peduncle, 4–10 cm wide at base, 1x-branched; the branches racemosely arranged, each bearing a subumbellate or cymose cluster of 9–15 flowers. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm. Calyx deeply split, lobes ovate or broadly lanceolate, 1.5–2 mm, acute or obtuse, with a few glandular dots. Corolla white or pink, 4–5 mm; tube ca 1 mm; lobes ovate, 2.5–3 mm wide, acute or obtuse, with scattered brown and black lineolate glands. Anthers ovate, ca 2 mm, apiculate, not punctate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5.5 mm. Drupe globose, 6–7 mm diam, red when ripe, longitudinally striate, ± dotted with glands.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia gigantifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 149. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1 m high; branchlets slender, terete, densely ferruginous puberulous when young, glabrous later. Leaves membranous; petiole 6–13 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 6.5–12.5 by 2–4 cm, broadest usually above the middle, ± cuspidate-acuminate, tapering towards the slightly obtuse base, entire or obscurely and remotely undulate near apex, glabrous except on the puberulous midrib beneath; glandular dots black or brownish, scattered prominent on both surfaces; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs, curved-ascending; reticulation of veins fine but prominent on both surfaces. Inflorescence lateral, subumbellate, in axils of fallen, reduced leaves near apex of branches, densely puberulous. Peduncle very slender, 1–2 cm, bearing (1–)2–4 flowers. Pedicel 8–13 mm. Calyx ca 2 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, ca 1.25 mm wide, acute, punctate, minutely ciliate. Corolla ca 5 mm, lobed nearly to base; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 2 mm wide, acute, with scattered brown glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 3.5 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style slender, ca 3.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia gracillima. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 123. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree to 3 m high; branchlets, petioles and inflorescence densely and persistently ferruginous villous or tomentose. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–12 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic, rarely oblanceolate, 7–21 by 2.5–7.5 cm, apex acuminate, tapering towards the obtuse base, denticulate on the upper half or sometimes entire, upper surface covered with short appressed hairs, sometimes glabrescent except the hairy impressed midrib, hairs on the lower surface usually longer and thicker, especially so on midrib; glandular dots pellucid or sometimes blackish and visible on both surfaces; lateral nerves 12–16 pairs, prominent beneath; veins usually obscure. Inflorescence corymbose or subumbellate racemes, in axils of reduced leaves or normal leaves on the lower part of the current year’s branchlets. Peduncle (3–)5–10 cm; rachis very short (elongating to 1–3 cm after anthesis), bearing 3–15 flowers. Pedicel 10–15 mm (2–2.5 cm in fruit). Flowers white, 6–7 mm. Calyx densely ferruginous villous, split almost to base; lobes ovate, ca 3 mm, acute. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 4 mm wide, with scattered dark purple glandular dots. Anthers ca 4 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 4 mm. Drupe globose, 6–7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia helferiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 118. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Undershrub ca 15 cm high. Stem rather thick, unbranched, young parts covered with short, capitate hairs. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm, narrowly winged; lamina elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 11.5–18.5 by 5–8 cm, apex acute, tip blunt, base obtuse to subrotund, subentire with remote and small callose teeth, glabrous; glandular dots scattered, obscure on both surfaces; lateral nerves 6–8 pairs, slender, curved-ascending, not forming intramarginal vein; reticulation of veins invisible. Inflorescence pseudoterminal, opposite to uppermost leaf just below the terminal bud, racemose but with flowers subumbellately arranged at apex, covered with short, capitate hairs. Peduncle (in fruit) ca 3 cm; rachis ca 2 cm. Pedicel 1.2–1.5 cm. Calyx lobes ovate, ca 2 mm, acute, erose-denticulate, obscurely punctate. Flowers unknown. Drupe globose, red when ripe, 6–7 mm diam, longitudinally striate and with orange to black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia integra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 99. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree to 6 m high; branchlets rather thick, obtusely quadrangular, glabrous, with scattered faint black dots. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1.5–2 cm, glabrous; lamina oblong-elliptic, 13–20 by 6.5 cm, apex acute, tip blunt, base cuneate, indistinctly undulate, glabrous, dotted with orange or black rounded or elongate glands on both surfaces; lateral nerves 20–25 pairs; reticulation of veins visible beneath. Inflorescence an axillary raceme, 7–13 cm long including peduncle. Pedicel 10–15 mm, glabrous and purplish, with scattered black dots. Flowers violet, 7–8 mm. Calyx split almost to the base; lobes suborbicular, 1.5–2 mm diam, membranous, dotted with purplish or black glands. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 3.5 mm wide, obtuse, with scattered purplish or black glandular dots. Anthers ca 5 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5 mm, punctulate. Drupe (immature) globose, ca 6 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia ionantha. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 118. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 7.5 m high; branchlets greyish, young parts densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 8–15 mm, scaly when young; lamina obovate-oblanceolate to obovate, 4.5–13 by 2–5.2 cm, apex rounded, then abruptly acuminate, with acumen 2–4 mm, base cuneate, entire and slightly recurved, upper surface glabrous, lower with scattered appressed rusty peltate scales; lateral nerves numerous, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge; veinlets indistinct. Inflorescence pseudoterminal, composed of simple or compound umbellate-corymbs. Peduncles of corymbs 8–25 mm, ± scurfy pubescent, bearing 4–9 subumbellate flowers, sometimes with short branches. Pedicel 5–8 mm, glabrous or nearly so. Calyx ca 1.25 mm, glabrous, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes ovate, obtuse or ± acute, dotted with brown glands, glandular-ciliate. Corolla ca 3 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, 1.5–2 mm wide, with scattered brown glands. Anthers ovate, ca 1.8 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3 mm, exserted before anthesis.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 89. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree; branchlets terete or slightly compressed, greyish, glabrous, young parts and inflorescence densely covered with ferruginous, scurfy hairs. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous; petiole 1–2 cm; lamina oblong or oblong-elliptic, 15–22 by 6–10 cm, apex broadly acute or abruptly acuminate, base obtuse or rounded, entire and slightly recurved, upper surface scaly when young, glabrous when mature, lower surface densely covered with rusty peltate scales; lateral nerves 24–30 pairs, parallel, arcuately connected near margin, as the midrib slightly impressed above, raised beneath; veinlets indistinct. Inflorescence terminal, paniculate, up to 16 cm long, with a spread of 10 cm at base, 2x branched; branchlets bearing umbellate clusters of 4–10 flowers; rachis somewhat compressed. Pedicel 2–5 mm. Calyx 1.5 mm, scaly at base, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes ovate, obtuse, with glandular dots, margin scarious, ciliate. Corolla pink, tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes ovate, ca 3 by 2.5 mm, acute, with a very few glandular dots near apex. Anthers ovate, ca 2 mm, apiculate. Ovary ovoid, glabrous; style ca 2 mm. Drupe globose, 4–5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia labisiifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 102. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large shrub or small tree to 10 m high; branchlets terete, greyish, glabrous or sometimes fugaciously rusty-scaly. Leaves subcoriaceous petiole 1.2–2 cm; lamina elliptic-oblong to elliptic-obovate, 15–28 by 5–9 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base long-cuneate, entire or sometimes obscurely crenate near apex, glabrous, lower surface with scattered minute impressed rusty scales; glandular dots scattered, colourless, slightly convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 12–16 pairs, with short intermediates, meeting in an irregular intramarginal vein; veins and veinlets usually prominent on the lower surface. Panicle terminal, pyramidal, 8–16 cm long, with a spread of 6–17 cm at base, 1–2x-branched, ferruginous-puberulous; rachis and branches compressed; branchlets bearing a corymbose cluster of 4–10 flowers. Pedicel 8–15 mm, thickened upwards. Flowers pink or red, 9–10 mm long, ca 1.7 cm diam. Calyx ca 6 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes orbicular or slightly depressed, 5–6 mm wide, apex rounded, base auriculate, margin denticulate and minutely ciliate. Corolla-tube ca 3 mm; lobes ovate, 6–7 by 5 mm, acute or obtuse, dotted with dark rounded glands. Anthers ca 5 mm long, gradually narrowed from the sagittate base, apiculate, with glandular dots on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 6 mm, rather thick at base, gradually narrowed into the punctiform stigma. Drupe globose, slightly depressed, smooth, 6–7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia lanceolata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 113. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 0.5–1.5 m high, glabrous throughout; branchlets terete or slightly angular, brownish when dry. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 6–19 by 1.5–6 cm, apex acuminate base cuneate, undulate-crenate, with large marginal glands, not punctate or with a few glandular dots along margin near apex, lower surface with sparsely scattered minute appressed rusty scales; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, slightly prominent on both surfaces, meeting in an irregular intramarginal vein near edge; veinlets not evident. Inflorescence a subsessile umbel, 3-many-flowered, terminal on special flowering branches, these up to 3–8 cm long, bearing only two leaves near apex. Pedicel ca 10 mm, pendant, lengthening to 15–30 mm in fruit. Calyx ca 2 mm, split almost to base; lobes oblong, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse, occasionally with one or two minute purple glandular dots. Corolla white, ca 4.5 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 2 mm wide, acuminate, with a few scattered very small purple glandular dots. Anthers ovate, ca 2.5 mm, sparsely punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Drupe globose, 5–6 mm diam, bright red when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia longipedicellata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 142. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 1–2.5 m high; branchlets slender, terete or slightly angular, glabrescent. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm; lamina elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 10–19 by 3–6 cm, apex acuminate, base acute, undulate-crenate, glabrous, with scattered minute rusty scales on lower surface at least when young; glandular dots generally colourless, scattered, convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 14–18 pairs, with short intermediates, meeting in an irregular intramarginal vein near edge; veins and veinlets fine, not evident. Inflorescence compound umbellate, terminal on branches, covered with ferruginous short hairs. Peduncle 5–10 mm; primary rays 2–3, 1–3 cm long, each bearing 3–7 flowers. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm, somewhat longer in fruit. Calyx 1.5–2 mm, split almost to base; lobes ovate to oblong, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse, membranous, glabrous, generally not punctate, rarely with 1–2 brown glandular dots. Corolla pink, 5–6 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate-lanceolate, 2.5–3 mm wide, acute, usually without coloured glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 3.5 mm, usually not punctate. Ovary glabrous; style 5–6 mm. Drupe globose, reddish or blackish, 7–9 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia maculosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 138. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 50 cm high; branches rather thick, terete, densely fulvous-villous, later glabrate, grayish-brown. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 10–15 mm, villous; lamina elliptic, 13–20 by 5–7 cm, apex acute or somewhat obtuse, base cuneate, obscurely and remotely crenulate above the middle, glabrous above, sparsely villous beneath when young, soon glabrate except on the midrib beneath; glandular dots and lines numerous, scattered, on young leaves; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, at some distance from the margin arcuately connected. Inflorescence subumbellate-corymbose, many-flowered, in axils of leaves near apex of branches, with indumentum as the branches but denser. Peduncle 3.5–4.5 cm. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm. Calyx ca 3.5 mm, split nearly to base; lobes broadly ovate to suborbicular, ca 3 mm wide, obtuse, pubescent, dotted with black and orange glands, fimbriate-ciliate. Corolla pink; tube ca 1 mm; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 7 by 5 mm, acute, densely marked with black and orange glandular dots and short lines. Anthers ca 6 mm, lanceolate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 4.5 mm, punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia maehongsonia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 120. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Undershrub to 1 m high; stems erect from the decumbent and rooting base, terete, young parts densely fulvous-villous. Leaves subopposite; petiole 1–3 cm, villous; lamina elliptic to obovate-oblanceolate 5.5–19 by 2.6–6 cm, apex acute to broadly acute, base cuneate or sometimes ± rounded, sharply serrate, thinly chartaceous, upper surface minutely hirtellous when young, soon becoming glabrous, lower surface hirsute-villous mainly on the raised midrib and nerves, dotted with dark or pellucid glands; lateral nerves 8–14 pairs, curved-ascending, anastomosing near edge. Inflorescence subumbellate, simple or compound, puberulous, in axils of reduced leaves near apex of stem. Peduncle 0.6–2 cm. Pedicel 5–10 mm. Calyx ca 1.5 mm, split nearly to base; lobes ovate, acute, rarely obtuse, punctate puberulous outside, minutely ciliate. Corolla pink to white, 3.5–4 mm; tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes narrowly ovate-elliptic, 1.5–2 mm wide, acute or obtuse, densely dotted with brown lineolate and rounded glands. Ovary lepidote-puberulous or sometimes glabrescent; style 1.5–2 mm. Drupe globose, 7–8 mm diam, bright red when ripe, dotted with dark glands.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia maingayi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 147. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to 6 m high; branchlets, inflorescence, petiole and underside of leaves densely covered with ferruginous scurfy hairs mixed with some stellate scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 8–16 mm; lamina oblong or elliptic-oblong, 8–16 by 3–5 cm, apex acute, tip blunt, base broadly cuneate or somewhat rounded, entire, upper surface drying dark brown, glabrous, lateral nerves 15–18 pairs, irregularly spaced, obscure above, raised beneath, departing at an angle about 65°, at some distance from the edge arching upwards and connected; veinlets slender, obscure on lower surface. Inflorescence a terminal lax leafy-panicle, up to 20 cm long, with a spread of 18 cm at base, 2x-branched; primary branches 1–4.5 cm, secondary branches 6–15 mm, bearing subumbeliate clusters of 6–10 flowers. Bracts foliaceous, spathulate or oblong-lanceolate, 2.5–5 cm. Pedicel ca 5 mm. Calyx ca 1.5 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes ovate-triangular, acute, ciliate, ± scaly. Corolla pink, ca 4 mm; lobes ovate, ca 2 mm wide, acute, shortly fused at base, with numerous pellucid glands. Anthers lanceolate, ca 3 mm. Ovary ovoid, glabrous; style ca 3 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia montana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 99. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree to 5 m high; branchlets slender, terete, or slightly angular, sparsely puberulous when young, later glabrescent; terminal bud densely ferruginous villous. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous, petiole 1–1.5 cm, initially puberulous, lamina narrowly elliptic to elliptic, 6–12 by 2.5–4 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate, entire glabrous, with scattered black glandular dots on both surfaces; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel, at some distance from margin arcuately connected; veinlets visible on both surfaces. Inflorescence umbellate, usually 2-flowered, emerging from lower part of the current year’s branch, sparsely puberulous. Peduncle 1–2 cm. Pedicel ca 1.5 cm, divaricate, arching upwards, slightly thickened towards apex. Flowers pink, 6–7 mm. Calyx ca 2 mm, split to ¾ of its length; lobes broadly ovate or orbicular, ca 2 mm wide, puberulous, with scattered glandular dots, fimbriate-ciliate. Corolla-tube ca 1.75 mm; lobes ovate, ca 4.5 mm wide, obtuse or ± acute, dotted with purplish or black glands. Anthers 4 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 4.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia multipunctata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 125. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–6 m high; branches glabrous, smooth, terete or obtusely angular. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole 5–15 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic, rarely oblong-lanceolate, 13–23 by 3.5–9 cm, apex acute or obtuse, rarely shortly acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse, glabrous on both surfaces; glandular dots many, slightly convex when dry, colourless; lateral nerves 12–14 pairs; veins and veinlets usually indistinct. Panicle terminal, 10–25 cm, erect or obliquely ascending, 1x-branched; branches 1–3 cm long, bearing 3–10 corymbosely arranged purple flowers. Pedicel 5–15 mm. Calyx ca 3 mm, split to ⅚ of its length; lobes ovate, cilitate, puberulous and glandular punctulate outside. Corolla-tube ca 1 mm; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 3 mm wide, acute, sparsely punctulate. Anthers lanceolate, ca 5 mm, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 6 mm. Drupe globose, ca 6 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia murtonii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 107. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 8 m high; branchlets grey, ± angular, young parts and inflorescence densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 5 mm; lamina elliptic, 7–13 by 2–4.5 cm, apex acuminate, tip ± blunt, base cuneate, entire or obscurely undulate, glabrous, lower surface covered with minute appressed rusty scales; glands numerous, translucent; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge; reticulation of veins and veinlets distinct on both surfaces. Inflorescence pseudoterminal, corymbose-paniculate, 1.5–4 cm long, with a spread of 2–7 cm at base, 1–2x-branched; the branchlets bearing 3–8 subumbellate flowers. Pedicel 4–7 mm. Calyx ca 1 mm, glabrescent, deeply split; lobes ovate, obtuse, ciliolate. Corolla white; tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes ovate, ca 2 by 2–2.5 mm, acute, with a few indistinct brown glands. Anthers 1.75–2 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style 3.5–4 mm, exserted before anthesis. Drupe depressed globose, ca 5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia nervosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 93. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small undershrub 30–60 cm high; stem usually unbranched, woody at base, upper part herbaceous, densely fulvous-villous. Leaves subopposite; petiole 3.5–5 cm, fulvous-villous, not winged; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic or slightly obovate-elliptic, 15–22 by 5.5–7 cm, apex acute, base long-cuneate, sharply denticulate-serrulate except for a short distance near the base, thinly chartaceous, glabrous above except on the puberulous midrib, fulvous-villous on veins beneath; glandular dots small and numerous, not prominent; lateral nerves 10–14 pairs, irregularly spaced, curved-ascending, anastomosing at some distance from the margin; veins prominent beneath. Inflorescence a slender panicle, composed of small corymbs, 4–15 cm long including the common peduncle. Peduncle of corymbs 2–5 mm long, bearing 2–4 flowers. Pedicel 5–8 mm, puberulous. Calyx ca 1.75 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, acute, dotted with thick black glands. Immature fruit oblong, beaked at apex, covered with rusty scales.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia odontophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1–3 m rarely to 6 m high, glabrous throughout; branchlets terete, greyish brown. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–3 cm; lamina elliptic, oblong-elliptic to oblong-oblanceolate 8–23 by 3.5–7 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate, entire glandular dots many, black, more numerous along the margin; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel; reticulation of veins visible on both surfaces. Inflorescence an abbreviated raceme axillary or occasionally subterminal, 5–8(–2)-flowered. Peduncle 2.5–5 cm, to 9 cm in fruit, ± compressed. Pedicel ca 1 cm in fruit. Flower-buds rounded, 4–5 mm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes orbicular, 2–2.5. mm diam, distinctly dotted with black glands, margin scarious, ciliate. Corolla reddish purple, 6–7 mm; tube less than 1 mm; lobes broadly ovate, 3.5–4 mm wide, obtuse or ± acute, densely dotted with rounded or lineolate glands. Anthers 4–5 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary ovoid, glabrous; style ca 4 mm. Drupe subglobose, ca 7 mm diam, with numerous black glandular dots.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia oxyphylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 129. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, to 15 m high; branchlets densely ferruginous-villous, glabrescent, with raised lines from the edge of the base of petioles. Leaves chartaceous or thinly coriaceous; petiole ca 1 cm, ferruginous-pubescent; lamina oblong-elliptic or slightly obovate, 13–24 by 4–8 cm, apex acute, base cuneate, entire, glabrous above, sparsely pubescent on nerves beneath; glands numerous near margins; lateral nerves 14–20 pairs; reticulation of veins distinct on both surfaces. Umbels 3–8-flowered, subsessile, in the axils of fallen leaves on old branches. Pedicel 10–13 mm, pubescent. Calyx ca 2 mm, split nearly to base; lobes ovate, obtuse or ± acute, pubescent and obscurely punctate outside, distinctly ciliate along the edge, strongly reflexed after flowering. Corolla white, deeply lobed; lobes broadly ovate, 6–7 mm long, short-acuminate, sparsely punctulate. Anthers ovate, cuspidate-acuminate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style as long as anthers. Drupe globose, 6–9 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia pachysandra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 87. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–5 m high; branchlets terete, greyish, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina elliptic-oblong to elliptic-obovate, 10–15 by 3.5–6.5 cm, apex shortly acuminate to ± acute, base cuneate, entire and slightly recurved, glabrous, upper surface dark green and somewhat shining, lower paler, with scattered minute appressed rusty scales; lateral nerves 10–12 pairs, faint on both surfaces; veinlets invisible. Inflorescence a terminal corymbiform panicle, 6–18 cm long, with a spread of 5–12 cm at base, ± rusty scaly, usually 1x-branched; branches ascending, bearing a corymbose or subumbellate cluster of 2–8 flowers. Pedicel 1–1.8 cm. Calyx 4–5 mm, split to ⅘ of its length; lobes oblong-elliptic, 2.5–3 mm wide, obtuse, glabrous, dotted with dark glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla pink, 10–11 mm, tube ca 1.5 mm; lobes ovate-lanceolate, acute, with scattered black or dark purple glandular dots and short lines. Anthers 4.5–5 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 7 mm. Drupe globose, slightly depressed, ca 6 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia palustris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 115. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–3 m high; branchlets grey, terete or compressed below inflorescence, glabrous. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–2 cm, often flattened at base, lamina elliptic-oblong, 15–36 by 6–15 cm, apex bluntly acute to obtuse, base broadly cuneate, entire, narrowly recurved, upper surface glabrous, lower sparsely covered with rusty scales; lateral nerves 20–35 pairs, parallel, arcuately connected near margin; veinlets obscure above, conspicuous beneath. Inflorescence a terminal pyramidal panicle, 12–18 cm long, with a spread of 15 cm at base, 3-branched; branchlets bearing 4–8 subumbellate flowers; rachis and branches compressed, sparsely covered with ferruginous scurfy hairs, glabrescent in fruit. Pedicel 2–4 mm. Calyx ca 2.5 mm, split to ⅘ of its length; lobes ovate, glabrescent, densely dotted with dark rounded and lineolate glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla ca 4.5 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, ca 2.5 mm wide, acute, with scattered glandular dots and lines. Anthers ovate, ca 2 mm, apiculate punctate on back. Ovary rounded, glabrous; style ca 3 mm. Drupe subglobose, ca 4 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia paralleloneura. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 102. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, ca 1.5 m high; branchlets obtusely quadrangular or terete, young parts and inflorescence ferruginous puberulous. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 5 mm, puberulous; lamina elliptic, 7–16 by 2.5–5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate to broadly cuneate, undulate-dentate, glabrous above, sparsely puberulous on nerves beneath; glandular dots large, dark brown, scattered, more numerous and distinct near the margin; lateral nerves 10–12 pairs, curved-ascending, anastomosing near edge; reticulation of veins prominent on both surfaces. Inflorescence a few-flowered corymbiform raceme, axillary. Peduncle 5 cm, with a small leaf (18 by 7 mm) at apex. Pedicel 15–20 mm. Calyx split almost to base; lobes ovate, 3–3.5 mm, acute, puberulous outside, with glandular dots, ciliate. Corolla pink; lobes ca 7 by 3–3.5 mm, acute, with scattered purplish glandular dots. Anthers ca 5 mm, acute, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia pedunculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 122. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 0.5–1 m high; stems terete or slightly angular, dark purplish brown or blackish, young parts and inflorescence densely rusty-pilose. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole 3–5 mm; lamina elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 2.5–8 by 1–3 cm, apex acute, tip blunt, base cuneate or obtuse, undulate-crenate and narrowly recurved, glabrous above, sparsely pilose and with appressed rusty scales beneath; glandular dots many, generally colourless, slightly convex when dry; lateral nerves 10–15 pairs, obscure above, subconspicuous beneath; veinlets usually invisible. Inflorescence subumbellate, many-flowered, terminal on apex of branchlets. Pedicel 12–15 mm. Flowers pink, 7–8 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes ovate, 2.5–3 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, glabrescent, thickly dotted with dark glands, margin somewhat scarious. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes ovate, 4–4.5 mm wide, acute, with scattered purple or black glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 5.5 mm, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 6 mm. Drupe globose, red when ripe, with black glandular dots, 6–7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia pilosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 142. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree to 8 m high, glabrous throughout; branchlets stout, terete or slightly angular, marked with large leaf scars. Leaves chartaceous; petioles 1–2 cm; lamina oblong-elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate or slightly oblanceolate, 12–20 by 4–8.5 cm, apex bluntly acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate, entire; glandular dots numerous, black, scattered, more distinct on young leaves; lateral nerves 12–20 pairs, with short intermediates, arching upwards at some distance from the margin. Inflorescence an abbreviated raceme, in axils of present or fallen upper leaves, usually many-flowered; peduncle 3–10 cm, thick and compressed; rachis very short at start of flowering, to 1–6 cm in fruit and usually recurved. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm at flowering. Flower-buds conical, 8–10 mm. Calyx 4–5 mm, deeply split; lobes broadly ovate to reniform, ca 3 mm wide, dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla pink, deeply lobed; lobes broadly ovate, acute or obtuse, dotted with black glands. Anthers oblong-lanceolate, ca 5 mm, apiculate, punctate on black. Drupe depressed globose, 7–9 mm diam, densely punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia polycephala. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 131. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree to 5 m high; branchlets terete or slightly compressed, densely ferruginous lepidote when young, later glabrescent, greyish, striate when dry. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 7–12 by 1.8–2.5 cm, apex obtuse or ± rounded, base cuneate, entire, upper surface glabrous, lower sparingly and minutely rusty-scaly; glandular dots numerous and minute, slightly convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs, with several shorter intermediates, prominent beneath; veinlets obscure. Inflorescence a terminal panicle, 2–3.5 by 1.5–2 cm, densely ferruginous lepidote; rachis somewhat zigzag, with 3–4 short branches, each bearing a subumbellate cluster of 3–7 flowers. Pedicel 1.5–2 mm. Flowers pale pink, ca 3 mm. Calyx ca 1 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate or triangular, obtuse, with glandular dots outside, margins scarious and minutely ciliate. Corolla lobed almost to base; lobes ovate, acute, with scattered black glandular dots. Anthers ovate, ca 1.5 mm, glandular-punctate dorsally. Ovary ovoid; style ca 4 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia puberula. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 104. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 3 m high; branchlets grey, obtusely guadrangular, somewhat sulcate when dry, swollen at base, young parts and inflorescence covered with appressed rusty peltate scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 10 mm; lamina elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 9–18 by 2.5–4.5 cm, apex shortly acuminate or ± acute, base cuneate, entire and slightly recurved, glabrous, lower surface with scattered minute rusty scales when young; glandular dots numerous, scattered, slightly convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 15–18 pairs; reticulation of veins and veinlets faint above, distinct beneath. Panicle axillary, on the upper part of branches, 5–7.5 cm long including the peduncle, with a spread of 2.5–5 cm at base, 1–2x branched; branchlets bearing 2–4 umbellate flowers. Pedicel 3–5 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes ovate ca 1 mm long, obtuse, ciliate, dotted with black glands. Corolla pink, deeply lobed; lobes ovate or ovate-oblong, ca 3 by 2 mm, obtuse, dotted with black and brown glands. Anthers ovate, ca 1.75 mm, acute. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5 mm, exserted before anthesis.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia punicea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 94. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, stem creeping at base, upper part ascendent, to 30 cm high, densely covered with light brown crisped long hairs when young. Leaves opposite or subverticillate; petiole ca 5 mm, villous; lamina elliptic-ovate or obovate, 1.5–6.5 by 1–3.5 cm, apex acute or obtuse, base acute or rounded, serrate or denticulate, chartaceous, upper surface sparsely strigose at least when young, lower surface strigose or mixed with long crisped hairs, with scattered minute orange glandular dots, especially along the margin; lateral nerves 4–6(–8) pairs, prominent beneath, ending in callose teeth; reticulation of veinlets conspicuous on both surfaces. Inflorescence umbellate, (1–)2–4-flowered, pubescent or hirsute, axillary from axils of reduced leaves. Peduncle slender, 1–4 cm. Pedicel 4–10 mm. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, 2.5–3 mm, acuminate, pilose or glabrescent, indistinctly punctate. Corolla white or pink, 3–4 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate or broadly ovate, acute, sparsely punctate. Anthers ovate, generally punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style equaling corolla-lobes. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam, red when ripe, dotted with small dark glands.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia pusilla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub usually 1.5–2 m, occasionally up to 6 m high; branchlets slender, terete, young parts densely covered with rusty peltate scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate or oblanceolate, 5–15 by 1.5–3(–4) cm, apex acuminate, tip blunt, base cuneate, entire and slightly recurved, upper surface glabrous, dull greyish green, lower brownish, generally covered with rusty scales; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge; veinlets indistinct. Inflorescence cymose or subumbellate, 2–12-flowered, lateral or pseudoterminal. Peduncle slender, (5–)10–25 mm. Pedicel 4–8 mm, as the peduncle glabrous or nearly so. Calyx 1–1.5 mm, split to ¾ of its length; lobes triangular-ovate, acute, minutely ciliate. Corolla white, ca 3 mm, deeply lobed; lobes broadly elliptic ovate, acute or obtuse, dotted with black glands. Anthers ovate, ca 1.25 mm, acute to apiculate, ± black-punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3 mm. Drupe typically depressed-globose, 5-angled, frequently globose and without angles.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia quinquegona. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 91. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1–5 m high; branchlets slender, spreading, minutely ferruginous pubescent. Leaves membranous; petiole 5–15 mm; lamina oblong-lanceolate, 8–20 by 3.5–4.5 cm, apex long acuminate, base cuneate or shortly narrowed, prominently and regularly undulate-crenate, upper surface glabrous, dark brown when dry, lower much paler, with scattered minute rusty peltate scales; glandular dots sparsely scattered on both surfaces; lateral nerves 10–14 pairs, irregularly spaced; veins and veinlets obscure. Inflorescence an umbellate-raceme, 3–12-flowered, subsessile, terminal on branchlets, these bearing only 2–3 leaves near apex. Pedicel slender, 1.7–3.4 cm, minutely rusty pubescent. Flower-bud ovoid. Calyx ca 1.8 mm, deeply split; lobes broadly triangular, acute or obtuse, sparsely punctate and puberulous. Corolla ca 3.75 mm; tube very short; lobes broadly ovate, ca 2.5 mm wide, acute, densely dotted with black glands. Anthers oblong ca 2 mm. Ovary glabrous; style slender, ca 1.5 mm. Drupe ovoid, 7–8 mm diam, dark red, sparsely striate and gland-dotted.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia ridleyi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 143. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Inflorescence glabrous; flowers larger, corolla ca 6 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia rigida laevis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 110. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m high; branchlets slender, terete or obtusely quadrangular, ferruginous pubescent when young, later glabrous, purplish brown when dry. Leaves thinly coriaceous; petiole 6–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptlc, 5–11 by 2–4 cm, apex acuminate to cuspidate-acuminate, rarely ± acute or obtuse, base broadly cuneate to acute, shallowly crentate and distinctly recurved, with large marginal glands, glabrous and shining above, covered with minute rusty scales beneath; lateral nerves 10–14 pairs, irregularly spaced, curved-ascending, connected near margin, usually ending in marginal glands; reticulation of veins invisible. Inflorescence compound-umbellate, terminal on branches, minutely ferruginous puberulous. Peduncle 5–10 mm, primary rays 1–2 cm, each bearing (2–)4–7 flowers. Pedicel 1.5–2 cm, white or pink. Calyx less than 1 mm, split to middle or a little below; lobes triangular to oblong-ovate, obtuse, glabrescent, not punctate. Corolla pink to purple, 6–8 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 2.5 mm wide, acute, glabrous, with a few purplish glandular dots. Anthers ca 3.5 mm, apiculate, sparsely punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5.5 mm. Drupe globose, black, 6–7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia rosea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 138. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub; branchlets terete or obtusely quadrangular, greyish, young parts densely covered with rusty scales. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm, rusty scaly; lamina lanceolate or narrowly oblong-lanceolate, 8–16 by 1.5–4 cm, apex acuminate, somewhat falcate, tip ± blunt, base cuneate, entire, slightly recurved, upper surface dull olive-brown when dry, glabrous, lower light brown, with scattered minute appressed rusty scales; glandular dots many, rather large, convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 20–25 pairs, with shorter intermediates, parallel; reticulation of veins indistinct. Inflorescence subumbellate, lateral on the upper part of branchlets, scurfy puberulous. Peduncle 8–20 mm; branches 5–10 mm. Pedicel ca 5 mm in fruit. Calyx split almost to base; lobes lanceolate, acute, distinctly ciliate. Corolla of immature flowers ca 2 mm long; lobes ovate, acute. Immature fruit globose, 4.5 mm diam, glabrous, with elongate glands.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia rubroglandulosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 95. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub ca 1 m high; branchlets slender, terete or obtusely quadrangular, densely covered with ferruginous scurfy hairs when young, glabrate and becoming grey or greyish brown with maturity. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 3–10 mm; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 6–16 by 1–3.5 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate, indistinctly undulate, glabrous, with a few scattered minute rusty scales on lower surface; glandular dots many, scattered, purplish or black, slightly convex on both sides, lateral nerves numerous, parallel, at a distance of 1.5–2 mm from margin, meeting in an intramarginal vein and with large elongate glands. Inflorescence umbellate, 3–6-flowered, ferruginous puberulous, terminal on flowering branches, 5–15 cm long, bearing 2–3 leaves near apex. Peduncle very short. Pedicel 10–15 cm. Calyx in fruit 2–2.5 mm, deeply split; lobes broadly ovate, ca 2 mm wide, acute, puberulous outside. Corolla not seen. Drupe spherical; ca 6 mm diam, sparsely puberulous, red when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia stipitata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 143. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 2 m high; branchlets obtusely quadrangular, young parts and inflorescence densely covered with ferruginous short hairs. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole ca 5 mm; lamina elliptic, 7–12 by 3–6 cm, apex shortly acuminate or subacute, tapering towards the ± obtuse base, entire or obscurely crenate on the upper half, glabrous above, sparsely covered with minute capitate hairs mainly on the nerves beneath; glandular dots many, black, scattered; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, curved-ascending, anastomosing near margin; reticulation of veins prominent beneath. Inflorescence subumbellate, 2–4-flowered, in axils of reduced leaves on young branchlets. Peduncle 1.3–2 cm, with foliaceous bracts, 5 by 2 mm, at apex. Pedicel 8–15 mm. Flowers pink, 7–8 mm. Calyx ca 3.5 mm, deeply split; lobes elliptic-ovate, ca 2 mm wide, obtuse, puberulous, dotted with small black glands, distinctly ciliate. Corolla-tube ca 0.5 mm; lobes ovate, 3.5 by 4 mm wide, acute, with rather dense purplish glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 4 mm. apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style 5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia subpilosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 125. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large shrub or small tree to 6 m high; branchlets terete or slightly angular, minutely rusty-scaly when young. Leaves ± crowded towards apex of branches; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic or elliptic-obovate, 8–18 by 3.5–6 cm, apex shortly acuminate or obtuse base cuneate, entire, thinly coriaceous, glabrous; glandular dots large, mainly along margins; lateral nerves 10–15 pairs, with short intermediates, raised beneath; veins visible on both surfaces when young. Inflorescence a terminal compact pyramidal panicle, 7–10 cm long, with a spread of 5–10 cm at base, ± scurfy-puberulous, 2x-branched; common peduncle none or very short; rachis rather thick; branchlets slender, bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel 5–7 mm long. Calyx split to ⅔ of its length; lobes orbicular, margin erose-denticulate and ciliolate. Corolla white; lobes broadly ovate, 3.5–4 mm long, acute, with a few brown glandular dots, margin denticulate. Anthers ovate, acute ca 2.5 mm long, dorsally punctate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia sumatrana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 112. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 1–2.5 m high; branchlets terete or slightly angular, glabrous. Leaves rigidly chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina 7–18 by 2–5 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base acute to obtuse, undulate-crenate, with distinct marginal glands, glabrous, not punctate or with a few glandular dots along the margin, rather densely covered with rusty scales on lower surface; lateral nerves 14–20 pairs, curved ascending, meeting in an inconspicuous intramarginal vein near edge; veins and veinlet fine, visible beneath. Inflorescence compound corymbose-umbellate, terminal on branches, covered with ferruginous short hairs. Peduncle 1–3 cm; primary rays 2–3, 3–6(–11) cm long, ± compressed in fruit, each bearing 4–8 flowers. Pedicel 1–1.5 cm. Calyx 2.5–3 mm, slightly enlarged in fruit, split nearly to base; lobes ovate, ca 1.5 mm wide, obtuse, with a very few obscure glandular dots, glabrous outside. Corolla pink, 5–6 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate-lanceolate, ca 2.5 mm wide, acute, with a few scattered purplish minute glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 4.5 mm. Drupe globose, 8–9 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia symplocifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 141. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 0.5–2 m high; branchlets slender, glabrous, with raised lines descending from base of petioles. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 6–10 mm; lamina oblong to elliptic-lanceolate, 7.5–15 by 2–4.5 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base cuneate, distinctly crenulate-denticulate; glabrous on both surfaces; glandular dots scattered, more numerous and prominent near margin; lateral nerves numerous and fine, at first parallel, then arching upwards and anastomosing at some distance from the margin; reticulation of veins prominent. Inflorescence a terminal panicle, 3–13 cm long, glabrous, 1x-branched; branches very slender, 2–10 cm long, bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel slender, 8–20 mm. Flowers 4-merous, buds slender. Calyx 1–1.25 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse, dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla pink, 5–6 mm, cleft nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, ca 1.75 mm wide, acute, with scattered black and orange glandular dots and short lines. Anthers linear-lanceolate, ca 5 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style slender, ca 5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia tetramera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 107. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, ca 0.3 m high; branches obtusely quadrangular, sparsely puberulous when young. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–2 mm, initially puberulous; lamina elliptic, 15–20 by 4–6 cm, apex acuminate to acute or subacute, base cuneate, undulate-crenate, glabrous and greyish green on both surfaces; glandular dots pellucid, numerous; lateral nerves 12–14 pairs, curved-ascending. Inflorescence lateral, just below the uppermost leaf of branches, umbellate, ca 6-flowered, ferruginous puberulous. Peduncle ca 10 mm. Pedicel thick, 8–10 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes ovate or triangular, ca 2 by 1.5 mm, obtuse, not punctate or sparsely punctate, puberulous outside, not ciliate. Corolla pink, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, 6 by 3–3.5 mm, subacute, glabrous, sparsely punctate. Anthers acuminate, sparsely punctate on back. Ovary ovoid, glabrous, ca 1 mm diam; style 4 mm. Drupe red, globose, ca 1 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia translucida. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 133. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 1.5 m high; branchlets blackish, marked by ridges descending from bases of petioles, glabrous, uppermost and the terminal bud covered with appressed peltate rusty scales. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole ca 5 mm; lamina lanceolate, 8.5–13.5 by 1.5–3 cm, apex acute, shortly tapered towards the base, entire, glabrous, upper surface deep green-black, lower purplish when dry; glandular dots few, scattered, colorless and inconspicuous; lateral nerves about 12 pairs, very obscure above, slightly prominent beneath; veins and veinlets invisible. Inflorescence lateral, racemose, in axils of reduced leaves near apex of branches, glabrous; peduncle 1.5–2.5 cm; rachis 1–1.5 cm; pedicel ca 1 cm. Calyx ca 1.75, split to ¾ of its length; lobes ovate, acute, with glandular dots, margin glabrous. Corolla purple (ex Kerr), 4.5–5 mm; tube ca 1 mm; lobes ovate, ca 2.5 mm wide, acute, indistinctly dotted with brownish glands. Anthers ovate, ca 2.5 mm, apiculate. Ovary glabrous; style 3 mm. Immature fruit globose, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia tristis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 97. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to 4 m high; bark smooth; branchlets reddish brown, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 8–15 mm, ± scaly; lamina elliptic to elliptic-oblanceolate, 8–14 by 2.8–5 cm, apex acuminate, base shortly attenuate to rounded, dark green and ± shining above, ferruginous lepidote beneath, lateral nerves 14–18 pairs, obscure on both surfaces, anastomosing near margin. Inflorescence a lax terminal panicle, 5–15 cm long, 2x-branched; rachis compressed, scaly; branchlets 3–6 mm, bearing an umbellate cluster of 3–8 flowers. Pedicel 2.5–4 mm. Calyx ca 0.8 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes ovate, ± blunt, punctate, minutely ciliate. Corolla white to light pink; tube ca 2 mm, lobes broadly ovate to orbicular, 1.8–2 by 1.5–2 mm, acute or obtuse, with a few reddish glandular dots. Anthers ovate, ca 1 mm, apiculate, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 2.8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia tuberculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 104. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub ca 0.3 m high; branchlets densely covered with rusty scales when young, later glabrescent, greyish, striate when dry. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm, initially rusty scaly; lamina narrowly elliptic, 5–10 by 1.5–3 cm, apex shortly acuminate or somewhat acute, base cuneate, crenate-dentate, with obtuse teeth, glabrous or with a few scattered rusty scales above, rather densely covered with rusty peltate scales beneath, especially on midrib; glandular dots many, scattered; lateral nerves 10–12 pairs, slightly raised beneath, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; veins and veinlets fine, visible on both surfaces. Inflorescence axillary, usually a 2-flowered simple umbel, rarely with 1–2 branches and in a few-flowered panicle. Peduncle equaling the pedicel (5–8 mm), all densely rusty scaly. Calyx ca 1.25 mm, split almost to base; lobes ovate, scaly outside, dotted with thick glands. Corolla-tube very short; lobes ovate, 2.5 by 2 mm, acute, dotted with red glands. Stamens ca 2 mm; anthers acute. Ovary ovoid; style ca 3.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia undulatodentata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 86. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub ca 0.5 m high; branchlets terete or slightly angular, densely rusty pubescent, glabrescent, dark brown. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 5 mm; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 7–14 by 2.8–4.5 cm, apex acuminate to cuspidate-acuminate, base cuneate, subentire or shallowly crenulate above middle, upper surface glabrous, lower ferruginous-pubescent mainly along nerves; glandular dots many, scattered, obscure, slightly convex when dry; lateral nerves 10–12 pairs; reticulation of veinlets fine, obscure. Flowers solitary, axillary. Pedicel ca 2.5 mm, ferruginous-pubescent. Calyx ca 3 mm, split almost to base; lobes ovate-elliptic, ca 2 mm wide, dotted with rounded brown or black glands, ciliate. Corolla white, ca 8 mm long; tube very short; lobes lanceolate, ca 3 mm wide at base, with a few glandular dots near apex. Anthers linear-lanceolate, ca 6 mm long. Ovary ovoid, pubescent; style slender, ca 7 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia uniflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 84. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, stem erect, 0.5–1 m high; young shoots, inflorescence and the midrib of leaves densely ferruginous villous or hirsute, the hairs often crisped. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm, densely villous; lamina elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, rarely oblanceolate, varying greatly in size, 4–20 by 1.5–7 cm, apex acuminate or acute, base cuneate, subentire or undulate-crenate, upper surface glabrous or nearly so (except on the impressed midrib), lower surface densely villous or hirsute; glandular dots many, black, scattered, conspicuous or sometimes obscure; lateral nerves 10–15 pairs, slender; veinlets very fine, obscure. Inflorescence umbellate, simple or compound, terminal on branches, rarely lateral on the main stem. Peduncle 0–2 cm. Pedicel 5–10 mm. Flowers pink to violet, rarely white, 5–7 mm. Calyx almost equaling the corolla, split nearly to base; lobes oblong-lanceolate, ca 2 mm wide, obtuse or acute, densely villous outside, with scattered black glandular dots. Corolla deeply lobed; lobes ovate 3.5–4 mm wide, acute, glabrous, with scattered glandular dots. Anthers lanceolate, ca 4.5 mm, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 5 mm. Drupe dark red or black, 5–7 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia villosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 144. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 1–3 m high; branches terete or obtusely quadrangular, glabrous, marked with black glandular lines. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm, lamina oblong-elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 9–20 by 3–8.5 cm, apex acuminate or abruptly acuminate, base cuneate, margin crisped or sometimes crenulate with large marginal glands, glabrous, sometimes with scattered minute appressed scales on lower surface, generally abundantly black-punctate, at least along the margin beneath; lateral nerves 15–20 pairs meeting in an intramarginaI vein near the edge; reticulation of veins usually distinct on both surfaces.
