Inflorescence compound-corymbose or subumbellate, glabrous, terminal on branches. Peduncle very short; primaly rays 3–7 cm, ± compressed, each bearing 4–8 flowers. Pedicel 1–2 cm, lengthening to 3 cm in fruit. Calyx split nearly to base; lobes oblong-ovate to suborbicular, 2.5–3.5 mm, obtuse, thickly dotted with black glands. Corolla white, 6–8 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate to broadly ovate, ca 4 mm wide, acute or obtuse, with scattered black or purplish glandular dots and short lines. Anthers ovate-lanceolate, 4.5–5 mm. Drupe globose, 7–9(–10) mm diam, red, densely marked with rounded and elongate black glands.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia virens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 134. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub, 20–50 cm high; branchlets thick, slightly angular ± pubescent when young. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 8–15 m, ± puberulous; lamina elliptic-obovate, 9–15 by 3–6 cm, apex shortly acuminate, base cuneate, remotely crenulate-dentate distally, glabrous on both surfaces; glandular dots numerous, scattered slightly convex on both surfaces when dry; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, prominent beneath, curved-ascending and anastomosing at some distance from the margin, the lowest pair at first almost parallel to the midrib; veins fine but visible. Inflorescence subumbellate, in axils of leaves near apex of branches, puberulous, 3–6-flowered. Peduncle 10–25 mm. Pedicel 10–13 mm. Flowers pink or white. Calyx 2.5–3 mm, split nearly to base; lobes ovate, ca 2 mm wide, acute, puberulous outside, dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Corolla ca 5.5 mm, deeply lobed; lobes ovate, ca 3.5 mm wide, acute, densely dotted with black glands. Anthers ca 3 mm, punctate on back. Ovary glabrous; style ca 3.5 mm. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Ardisia wallichii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 122. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber to 30 m long; branchlets reddish, sparsely puberulous and lepidote when young, later glabrous; old branches striate and verruculose. Leaves rigidly coriaceous; petiole ca 1 cm; lamina oblong to oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, (12–)15–25 by 4–10 cm, apex acute, base rounded or almost cordate, entire, glabrous, with scattered, depressed rusty scales on lower surface; glandular dots many, scattered, visible on young leaves; lateral nerves numerous, parallel, obscure or subconspicuous. Inflorescence a terminal pyramidal panicle, 15–30 cm long and broad, densely puberulous, 3–4x-branched; branchlets bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel very short or to 1 mm in fruit. Flowers 5-merous. Calyx ca 0.5 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes triangular, acute, dotted with a very few dark glands, puberulous outside. Corolla greyish white; lobes free, ovate, ca 1 mm, glabrous without, slightly papillose within, dotted with dark glands. Stamens adnate to middle of corolla-lobes. Ovary ovoid; style very short; stigma capitate. Drupe globose, ca 2 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia coriacea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 156. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub; branches glabrous, greyish brown, with raised lenticels. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 2–2.5 cm; lamina obovate or broadly obovate-elliptic, 8–20 by 5–12 cm, widest above middle, apex broadly obtuse or ± acute, base cuneate to rounded, sometimes asymmetrical, entire, glabrous; glandular dots many, black, chiefly visible on lower surface; lateral nerves 10–18 pairs, with short intermediates, conspicuous on both surfaces when dry. Inflorescence racemose, 2–4 cm, lateral on branches of previous year’s growth, glabrous. Flowers 4-merous, sessile. Calyx ca 1.75 mm, split nearly to base; lobes ovate, acute or obtuse, ca 1 mm wide, ciliolate, dotted with dark glands. Corolla-lobes free, elliptic or oblong, ca 3 by 1.5 mm, obtuse or rounded, glabrous without, puberulous within. Stamens adnate to base of corolla-lobes; anthers oblong, 1–1.25 mm, punctate on back; pistillode small. Staminodes shorter than corolla-lobes; ovary pyramidal; style very short. Drupe globose, 1–1.2 cm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia grandifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 163. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub; branchlets slender, ferruginous puberulous. Leaves chartaceous to subcoriaceous; petiole 5–8 mm, with crisped narrow wings; lamina oblong-elliptic, 5–11 by 2–5 cm, apex broadly acute to obtuse, base obtuse to rounded, minutely and sparsely serrate on the upper half or subentire, upper surface glabrous, lower surface minutely puberulous on the strongly raised midrib; lateral nerves 12–14 pairs, ± impressed above, distinctly raised beneath. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 0.5–2 cm long, ferruginous puberulous. Pedicel ca 1.5 mm. Flowers pale green, 5-merous. Calyx ca 1.2 mm, split to ⅔ of its length; lobes broadly ovate, obtuse, minutely ciliate and sparsely punctate. Corolla-lobes free, oblong or elliptic, 2–2.5 by 1 mm, obtuse, glabrous without, sparsely papillose within, dotted with black glands. Stamens ca 3 mm long, inserted on base of corolla-lobes, anthers broadly ovate, ca 0.5 mm, obtuse, inconspicuously punctate on back; pistil much reduced. Female flower unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia impressa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 159. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub; branchlets slender, puberulous when young. Leaves rigidly chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm, with narrow, crisped wings; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 3–10 by 2–3.5 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base broadly cuneate to subrounded, entire, upper surface glabrous, lower slightly puberulous on the strongly raised midrib; lateral nerves 8–14 pairs, with short intermediates. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate, 1–4 cm long, ferruginous puberulous. Pedicel 2–4 mm. Calyx ca 1 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, acute, ca 0.6 mm wide, puberulous outside, minutely ciliate and obscurely punctate. Corolla-lobes almost free, oblong-elliptic, 3–3.5 by 1–1.25 mm, ciliate, distinctly dotted with small dark glands, glabrous or nearly so without, densely papillose within. Stamens ca 2 mm, adnate to base of corolla-lobes; anthers ovate, ca 1 mm; pistillode small. Female flower unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 161. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sturdy climber; branchlets rather thick, glabrous, dark brown to blackish, with scattered raised lenticels. Leaves conaceous; petiole 1.5–2.5 cm; lamina elliptic or ± obovate, 9–18 by 5–10 cm, widest at middle, apex broadly obtuse or shortly acuminate, base subrounded, entire, slightly recurved, glabrous, dotted with small black glands on both surfaces; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, with short intermediates, irregularly spaced; reticulation of veins and veinlets obscure. Inflorescence racemose, lateral on branches of previous year’s growth, in fruit 2.5–4 mm long, glabrous; rachis thick, somewhat angular; pedicel 3–5 mm, rather thick; the persistent calyx 1.5–2 mm, lobes 4, broadly triangular, acute, ca 1.25 mm wide at base, dotted with black glands, minutely ciliate. Drupe globose, 1.2–1.8 cm diam, smooth, wrinkled when dry.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia macrocarpa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 162. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub or climber to 10 m long; branchlets glabrous or puberulous. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm, with narrow crisped wings in distal part; lamina oblong-elliptic to oblong-ovate or elliptic-lanceolate, 6–10 by 2–3.5 cm, apex acute, base rounded or obtuse, margin usually remotely serrate in upper half or near apex, rarely entire, glabrous, not punctate or with minute glands near apex on lower surface; lateral nerves 10–18 pairs, with short intermediates. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 1–3 cm, ferruginous puberulous. Pedicel 3–4 mm, patent, usually at right angles to the rachis. Flowers 5-merous, greenish or white, 2.5–3 mm. Calyx deeply split; lobes broadly ovate, 0.5–0.7 mm, ciliate, sparsely and minutely punctate, glabrous or nearly so. Corolla-lobes free, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, ca 1 mm wide, broadly obtuse or slightly emarginate, glabrous without, densely papillose within, dotted with brown glands. Stamens adnate to base of corolla-lobes; anthers ovate, punctate on back. Pistil a little shorter than the corolla, with pyriform glabrous ovary and short curved style. Drupe globose, 5–6 mm diam, red when mature.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia oblongifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 161. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub or climber, to 3 m long; branchlets slender, generally distichous, densely ferruginous-villous. Leaves distichous, petiole 1–2 mm, villous; lamina suboblong, 1.5–4.5 by 0.8 1.7 cm, apex acute to obtuse or rounded, base broadly obtuse to truncate or subcordate, entire, upper surface, except the impressed puberulous midrib, glabrous, lower surface conspicuously ferruginous-lepidote, pubescent on the raised midrib, densely dotted with dark glands near apex. Inflorescence axillary, subumbellate or cymose, 2–5 mm long, with 5–7 flowers. Pedicel 1–3 mm, ferruginous pubescent. Flowers white or yellowish, 5-merous, 2–2.5 mm long. Calyx deeply split; lobes oblong-ovate or oblong-lanceolate, ca 1 mm wide, ciliate, ± pubescent outside, punctate near apex. Corolla-lobes ± united at base, ovate or oblong, obtuse, 0.8–1 mm wide, puberulous without, densely papillose within. Stamens adnate almost to middle of corolla-lobes; anthers ovate or elliptic-ovate, punctate on back. Pistil in female flowers about half the length of the corolla; ovary pubescent; style ca 0.4 mm. Drupe globose, 4–5 mm diam, ± pubescent and punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia pulchella. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 156. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub or climber, usually 3–6 m, sometimes to 13 m long; branchlets slender, young parts (under the inflorescence) minutely puberulous, soon becoming glabrous. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 4–8(–10) by 1.2–3 cm, apex shortly acuminate, tip blunt, base cuneate or rounded, entire, slightly recurved, glabrous; glandular dots many, scattered, black or colourless, slightly convex when dry; lateral nerves numerous, obscure in fresh state. Panicle terminal, 10–20 cm long, with a spread of 10–18 cm at base, densely puberulous, 2–3x branched; branchlets slender, bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel 1–2 mm. Flowers greenish or white, 5- rarely 4-merous. Calyx ca 0.5 mm, split about to middle; lobes triangular, acute or obtuse, densely puberulous. Corolla-lobes almost free, elliptic, ca 1.5–2 mm, with a few glandular dots, densely papillose outside. Stamens adnate ± to middle of corolla-lobes and slightly shorter than them; anthers ovoid or oblong, punctate on back. Pistil reduced in male flowers, ± shorter than corolla-lobes in female flowers, with ovoid glabrous ovary and capitate stigma on a short style. Drupe globose, 3–4 mm in diam, reddish or black, fleshy, wrinkled when dry.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia ribes. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 154. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Straggling shrub or climber, 2–5(–8) m long; branches slender, glabrous, greyish to dark brown. Leaves rigidly chartaceous or coriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic to elliptic, 5–11 by 2.5–4.5 cm, apex acute, tip blunt, base broadly cuneate or subrounded, entire or obscurely and remotely serrate near apex, upper surface dark green, sometimes slightly lustrous, lower paler, dotted with dark glands along the margin and near apex; lateral nerves 6–10 pairs, prominently raised beneath. Inflorescence racemose, lateral, 1–5 cm long, ± covered with minute capitate hairs. Pedicel ca 2 mm. Flowers white or greenish, 5-rarely 4-merous, ca 2 mm. Calyx ca 0.75 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, obtuse, glabrescent, sparsely punctate. Corolla-lobes free, elliptic to oblong-obovate, ca 1 mm wide, rounded or obtuse, glabrous without, minutely papillose within, punctate. Stamens in male flowers adnate near to base of corolla-lobes and exceeding them in length; anthers broadly ovate, ca 0.4 mm. In female flowers, staminode much shorter; ovary pear-shaped, glabrous; style ca 0.5 mm, curved; stigma capitate. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia scandens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 158. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub or climber, 3–6 m long; branchlets slender, light brown, minutely puberulous when young, rapidly becoming glabrous. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic or oblong-ovate, 5–11 by 2.5–5 cm, apex shortly acuminate, tip blunt, base rounded, entire and slightly recurved, glabrous, usually not punctate; lateral nerves 8–14 pairs, with several short intermediates, ± conspicuous on lower surface when dry. Panicle terminal, 10–15 cm long, with a spread of 6–15 cm at base, 1–2x-branched, densely puberulous; branchlets slender, ± angular, bearing many sessile or subsessile flowers (pedicel less than 1 mm). Calyx ca 0.75 mm, split to middle; lobes ovate, acute, papillose, distinctly ciliate. Corolla greenish or white, lobes free, narrowly elliptic, 1.5–2.7 mm, obtuse, papillose on both sides, densely puberulous along margin. Stamens adnate to middle of corolla lobes; anthers ovoid or oblong, nearly equaling filaments. In female flowers ovary glabrous; style short; stigma capitate. Drupe globose, ca 5 mm diam, fleshy, wrinkled when dry.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia sessiliflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 155. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Straggling shrub; branchlets slender, terete, sparsely ferruginous pubescent. Leaves thinly chartaceous; petiole 1–1.5 cm; lamina elliptic-oblanceolate, 8–15 by 2.5–6 cm, apex acuminate or acute, base cuneate, conspicuously dentate, upper surface minutely strigose or glabrescent, lower puberulous on midrib and nerves; lateral nerves 6–8 pairs; veins slender, conspicuous beneath. Inflorescence axillary, racemose, 1.5–3 cm long, ferruginous puberulous. Pedicel ca 2 mm. Calyx ca 1 mm, split nearly to base; lobes lanceolate, ca 0.4 mm wide, ciliate, puberulous outside. Corolla-lobes almost free, elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, ca 2 by 0.8 mm, ± acute, glabrous without, densely papillose within, dotted with black glands. Stamens inserted on corolla-lobes a little below the middle; anthers broadly ovate, ca 0.6 mm, pistil much reduced. Female flowers and fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia sootepensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 158. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub or small tree, 3–5 m high; branches glabrous, ± lenticellate-warty. Leaves coriaceous or rigidly chartaceous; petiole (0.5–)1–2 cm; lamina obovate or obovate-elliptic, 8–15 by 3.5–6.5 cm, apex acute, broadly obtuse or abruptly acuminate, base cuneate or subobtuse, entire, glabrous, dotted with numerous minute black glands; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs, with some short intermediates, usually conspicuous on both surfaces when dry. Inflorescence racemose, 3–5 cm, usually emerging from axils of leaf scars on branches of previous year’s growth, glabrous or nearly so. Pedicel 0.5–1.5 mm. Flowers 4-merous, greenish or yellowish white, 2.5–3 mm long. Calyx less than 1 mm, deeply split; lobes triangular or ovate, acute, glabrous, with dark glands. Corolla lobes free, oblong-elliptic, 1–1.5 mm wide, obtuse, glabrous outside, densely papillose inside. Stamens adnate halfway to corolla-lobes; anthers oblong, ca 1 mm, black-punctate on back; staminodes shorter than corolla-lobes; ovary glabrous; style ca 1 mm. Drupe globose, 8–10 mm diam, longitudinally ridged or wrinkled, densely black-punctate.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia subcoriacea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 162. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: A complex and variable species; variation of indumentum density show a range from E. tsjeriamcottam (E. robusta) through E. villosa to E. ferruginea. As indicated by C.B.Clarke and Fletcher, it appears impossible to find a satisfactory disjunction between these three species. Here, following C.B.Clarke, two varieties are recognized, but they integrate considerably and show no geographical separation.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia tsjeriamcottam. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 157. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Indumentum very thick, secondary veins invisible on the lower surface of leaves.
bibliographicCitation: Embelia tsjeriamcottam ferruginea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 158. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Semi-herbaceous undershrub, stem ascendent or erect, 5–15 cm high, young parts, petioles and inflorescence densely covered with ferruginous scales. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 2.5–8 cm, ± winged; lamina elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 13–21 by 2.5–6.5 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneately narrowed and ± decurrent on the petiole, obscurely crenulate, glabrous, lower surface with scattered rusty scales especially on the raised midrib; lateral nerves numerous and fine, parallel. Panicle axillary, 2–8 cm long, with a spread ca 1.3 cm at base, composed of small corymbs; peduncles of corymbs ca 1 mm, bearing 1–4 flowers. Bracts lanceolate to subulate, 1.5–3 mm. Pedicel 1–2.5 mm. Calyx ca 1.75 mm, deeply split; lobes triangular, acute, distinctly punctate. Corolla pink or white, 2.5–3 mm; lobes ovate, acute, with glandular lines and small dots. Stamens infolded in the corolla-lobes. Anthers oblong-ovate, ca 1.5 mm, with a gland at tip. Ovary ovoid, slightly scaly; style slender, ca 1.5 mm. Fruit globose, ca 4 mm diam, with vertical elongate glands.
bibliographicCitation: Labisia pumila. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 151. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen shrub to 1 m high; branchlets minutely and rather densely puberulous. Leaves rigidly chartaceous; petiole 8–14 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic to elliptic, 10–16 by 4–6 cm, apex acuminate or cuspidate-acuminate, base broadly cuneate to obtuse, serrate except the lower ¼, with callose teeth, upper surface dull olive-green, glabrous, lower greyish green, sparsely puberulous on the main nerves; lateral nerves 7–9 pairs; veins invisible, not glandular-striate or obscurely so. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate (with 1–2 branches at base), 1–2.5 cm, densely puberulous. Pedicel ca 1.5 mm. Flowers white, ca 3 mm. Calyx puberulous; lobes ovate, ca 0.75 mm, distinctly ciliate and glandular-striate. Corolla ca 2.5 mm, lobes ca ¼ the length of tube, suborbicular, glandular-striate. Anthers oblong, ca 0.2 mm. Ovary glabrous; style ca 0.2 mm. Fruit globose, ca 2.5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa argyrophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 168. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree, 4–5 m high; branchlets densely and persistently hirsute. Leaves rigidly chartaceous; petiole 1–2 cm, densely hirsute; lamina oblong-elliptic, 8–16 by 4.5–9 cm, apex acute or obtuse, base rounded, coarsely serrate except for a short distance near the base, upper surface hirsute when young, later glabrescent except on midrib, lower surface persistently hirsute, especially on nerves; lateral nerves 8–11 pairs; veins invisible. Inflorescence a many-flowered, crowded panicle, axillary, 0.5–2.5 cm long, composed of short racemes, densely hirsute. Pedicel 1–2 mm. Calyx-lobes ca 0.5 mm, triangular, puberulous outside, ciliate. Corolla white, ca 2.5 mm, lobed to ⅖ of its length; lobes broadly ovate to suborbicular, ca 1.2 mm wide, with slender brown glandular striations. Ovary glabrous; style ca 0.5 mm; stigma slightly 3–4-lobed. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa glomerata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 170. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large shrub, 1–3(–5) m high; branchlets glabrous, distinctly lenticellate, the soft part often sulcate when dry. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–4 cm; lamina elliptic to broadly elliptic, rarely ovate or oblong-ovate, (6–)8–17 by 4–8(–15) cm, apex acuminate to shortly acuminate, base cuneate to obtuse or subrounded, serrate, with callose teeth, glabrous, with distinct nerve-like glandular striations; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs; veins very fine, not evident. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate, 2–6 cm, glabrous or slightly glandular. Pedicel 1–2 mm. Calyx-lobes ovate, 0.8–1 mm, longer than tube, ciliate. Corolla white or yellowish light green, ca 2 mm, lobed to ca middle; lobes broadly ovate, rounded, inconspicuously glandular-striate. Anthers rounded. Pistil slightly shorter than calyx-lobes; stigma slightly lobed. Fruit subglobose, ca 4 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 175. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect or scandent shrub, 1.5–4 m high; branchlets glabrous, with scattered raised lenticels. Leaves chartaceous; petiole (1–)1.5–3.5 cm; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, (10–)13–25 by 5–12 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base obtuse or rounded, entire to undulate or crenate-dentate, glabrous not glandular-striate or obscurely so; lateral nerves 7–10 pairs, curved-ascendlng ending in marginal glands or excurrent into teeth; veinlets obscure. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate (with 1–3 branches at base), 1–3(–5) cm long, minutely glandular. Pedicel 1–2 mm. Calyx-lobes ovate, ca 1 by 0.8–1 mm, obtuse, ciliate. Corolla white, ca 2 mm, lobed to middle; lobes suborbicular, ca 1.5 mm wide, rounded and minutely denticulate at apex. Anthers elliptic, ca 0.4 mm. Pistil slightly shorter than calyx; stigma capitate. Fruit subglobose, ca 4 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa integrifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 173. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Scandent shrub, ca 2 m high; branchlets terete or obtusely quadrangular sparsely puberulous when young, soon becoming glabrous, greyish brown. Leaves chartaceous; petiole ca 2 cm; lamina elliptic, 5–15 by 3–6 cm, apex acute-attenuate, base cuneate, dentate, glabrous, upper surface greyish green, nerves conspicuous, lower paler, with distinct nerve-like glandular striations; midrib and 6–8 pairs of lateral nerves prominent; veinlets obscure. Flowers unknown. Inflorescence axillary, ca 5 mm, glabrous. Fruit elliptic, white, 5–7 mm long, 3–5 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa lineolata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 172. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–3 m high; branchlets generally sparsely pilose or puberulous, sometimes glabrous. Leaves rigidly chartaceous; petiole 5–10 mm; lamina oblong-elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, rarely broadly ovate, 7–16 by 3–7 cm, apex acute or acuminate, with callose teeth, upper surface glabrous, lower glabrescent or occasionally sparingly hirsute, especially on nerves; glandular striations invisible or sometimes evident; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs; veinlets not evident. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate, 2–7(–10) cm, sparingly hirsute or puberulous. Pedicel 1–2(–3) mm. Flowers white, ca 2 mm. Calyx-lobes ovate, ca 0.6 by 0.6 mm, obtuse, minutely ciliate. Corolla ca 2 mm, lobed to middle; lobes broadly ovate or suborbicular, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse or rounded, entire or slightly crenulate. Anthers suborbicular, ca 0.25 mm. Pistil slightly longer than calyx; stigma minutely bilobed. Fruit globose or ovoid, 2.5–4 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa montana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 175. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or climber to 4 m tall; branchlets glabrous, sparsely lenticellate. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 1–1.8 cm; lamina elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 10–20 by 5–10 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded or obtuse, dentate, with coarse or occasionally minute teeth, glabrous, obscurely glandular-striate on both surfaces; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, prominent beneath; veinlets obscure. Inflorescence terminal, paniculate, to 35 cm long, with a spread of 30 cm at base, 1–2x-branched, glabrous or nearly so; branchlets bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel 1.5–2 mm, puberlous. Calyx 1.75 mm; lobes ovate, ca 1 by 1 mm, obtuse, obscurely puberulous outside, minutely ciliate. Corolla hardly exceeding calyx, ca 1.5 mm, lobed to middle; lobes suborbicular, slightly glandular-striate. Anthers depressed elliptic, ca 0.1 mm. Pistil about half the length of calyx; stigma obtuse. Fruit globose, 3–4 mm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Maesa paniculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 2, 1996. Pg. 171. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub 1–3 m high; branchlets hirsute or pubescent. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 7–10 mm, hirsute; lamina elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 7–11 by 3–5 cm, apex acute or abruptly acuminate, base cuneate, coarsely serrate except for a short distance near base, upper surface hirsute, or pilose when young, rapidly becoming glabrous except midrib, lower surface hirsute, especially on main nerves; lateral nerves 7–9 pairs. Inflorescence axillary, racemose or paniculate (with 2–3-branches), hirsute or puberulous. Pedicel 1.5–2 mm. Calyx-lobes ovate, ca 0.75 mm, ciliate, puberulous outside. Corolla white, ca 2 mm, lobed to middle; lobes broadly ovate to suborbicular, ca 1 mm wide, obtuse, glandular-striate. Anthers broadly ovate to reniform, not punctate. Ovary glabrous; style ca 0.75 mm; stigma obscurely 4-lobed. Fruit globose, ca 3 mm diam, striate from the elongated vertical glands.

description: Shrub, 1–3 m, occasionally to 6 m high; young branches, petioles and inflorescence densely rufous-hirsute. Leaves chartaceous; petiole 2–3.5 cm; lamina broadly elliptic to elliptic or oblong-obovate, 12–25(–30) by (5–)8–18 cm, apex abruptly and shortly acuminate, base broadly cuneate to subrounded, serrate-dentate, with callose teeth, upper surface glabrous or nearly so, lower surface densely pilose or hirsute, especially on nerves, hairs brownish, arising from tuberculate processes; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, irregularly spaced, prominent beneath; veins invisible. Inflorescence racemose or subpaniculate, contracted and clustered in leaf axils, shorter than petiole. Pedicel ca 1 mm. Flowers yellowish or white, ca 3 mm. Calyx lobes equaling tube, ovate, acute, ciliate, densely pilose or hirsute outside. Corolla campanulate or somewhat urn-shaped, tube ca 2 mm, slightly contracted at apex; lobes ca 0.75 mm, suborbicular, glandular-striate. Fruit globose, 4–5 mm diam, densely hirsute.

description: Large shrub or tree 1.5–5(–10) m high; branchlets glabrous. Leaves chartaceous or subcoriaceous; petiole 6–10 mm; lamina ovate-lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate or ovate, 8–16 by 2–6 cm, apex acuminate to long-acuminate, rarely acute, base broadly obtuse to rounded, entire or remotely and minutely dentate; glabrous; lateral nerves 5–8 pairs; veins obscure. Inflorescence axillary or subterminal, paniculate, 4–12 cm long, 2–9 cm wide at base, 1–2x-branched; branchlets slender, bearing many racemosely arranged flowers. Pedicel 1–1.5 mm, glabrous or sparsely puberulous. Calyx ca 0.75 mm lobed to middle; lobes patent, broadly ovate, obtuse, glabrous, minutely ciliate. Corolla white, ca 1.5 mm, lobed to middle; lobes suborbicular, ca 1.2 mm wide. Anthers small, orbicular. Pistil slightly exceeding calyx; stigma bilobed. Fruit globose, 2–2.5 mm diam.

description: Large shrub or small tree, 3–7 m high; branchlets with raised lines descending from leaf-petioles, glabrous or sparsely pubescent near apex. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole 3–8(–10) mm; lamina elliptic to lanceolate, 5–13 by 1.5–4 cm, apex acute or acuminate, base cuneate, generally serrate on the upper half, glabrous, with scattered dark or orange glandular dots on both surfaces, especially along the margin. Flowers 4-merous, white or yellowish, 3–7 fascicled or in umbels. Pedicel 2–3 mm, glabrous or slightly puberulous. Calyx ca 1 mm, split a little below middle; lobes ovate or triangular, acute or obtuse, distinctly punctate. Corolla 2–2.5 mm, lobes oblong to oblong-lanceolate, shortly connate at base, acute or obtuse. Stamens inserted on base of corolla-lobes; filaments very short; anthers oblong, ca 2.5 mm, apiculate, equaling or slightly longer than the corolla-lobes; pistillode small. Staminode shorter than corolla-lobes; ovary ovoid, glabrous, or nearly so; style ca 0.5 mm; stigma bilobed; the lobes flattened, 1–1.75 mm long and broad, fimbriate. Fruit globose, 5–7 mm diam, from red becoming bluish black when ripe.

description: Dioecious shrub or small tree; branchlets slender, 2–2.5 mm thick measured at 10 cm behind the apex. Leaves subcoriaceous; petiole ca 5 mm; lamina oblong to oblong-lanceolate 4–9 by 2–3.5 cm, apex ± obtuse and emarginate, base cuneate, entire, with numerous small rounded and lineolate black glands, especially 2 along the margin; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs; veinlets obscure. Umbels 3–5-flowered. Pedicel 1–2 mm, slightly angular. Calyx ca 1 mm, deeply split; lobes ovate, acute, ciliate, with scattered dark glandular dots and lines. Corolla greenish white, ca 2.5 mm, lobed to ¾ of its length; lobes elliptic, obtuse, papillose on margin, with dark rounded and lineolate glands. Staminodes inserted on base of corolla-lobes; anthers small, subsessile; ovary ovoid, glabrous, with an oblique and folded stigma. Fruit globose, ca 3 mm diam., dark blue when ripe, with elongate vertical glands.

description: Dioecious shrub or small tree to 5 m high; branchlets robust, usually > 3 mm thick measured at 10 cm behind the apex. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 3–8 mm; lamina elliptic-obovate, 5–9 by 2–3.5 cm; apex ± rounded and emarginate, base cuneate, entire, with numerous glandular dots and lines on both surfaces; lateral nerves 8–12 pairs, slender, inconspicuous; veinlets very obscure. Inflorescence umbellate. Pedicel slender, 3–4 mm, 5–8 mm in fruit, glabrous. Flowers white, fragrant. Calyx very small, ca 0.5 mm, lobes broadly ovate to suborbicular. Corolla-lobes shortly fused at base, lanceolate, ca 2 by 0.75 mm, with scattered brown glandular dots and short lines. In female flowers, staminodes adnate to lower part of corolla-lobes; anthers subsessile, ovate, ca 0.5 mm; ovary globose, glabrous; stigma ca 1.5 mm, with 2–3 slender branches. Fruit globose, 4–5 mm diam.

description: Dioecxous shrub or small tree, 4–7 m, occasionally to 18 m high; branchlets somewhat thick, dark brown to almost black when dry; scales of terminal buds large, sparsely pubescent, ciliate. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 6–12 mm; lamina elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, (5–)8–18 by 2.5–6 cm, apex acute or obtuse, base cuneate, entire, slightly recurved, glabrous, with numerous tiny sunken pits beneath; lateral nerves numerous, parallel, meeting in an intramarginal vein near edge. Umbels usually many-flowered. Pedicel rather thick, 0.5–2 mm. Flowers light green. Calyx-lobes ovate to broadly ovate, ca 1.5 mm, obtuse or acute, fused at base, ciliate, with a few glandular dots near apex. Corolla 2.5–3 mm, lobed to ⅘ of its length; lobes oblong-lanceolate, ca 1 mm wide, acute, sparsely punctate, densely papillose along the margin. Stamens adnate about to base of corolla-lobes. Anthers ovate, ca 1 mm. Ovary ovoid; stigma ca 3 mm, curved and slightly lobed at apex. Fruit globose ca 5 mm diam.
